title: Demo: Real-time Generative Multicasting with On-Device Intent-aware Semantic Decomposition
abstract: arXiv:2608.14600v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present a demonstration for generative multicasting with on-device, intent-aware semantic decomposition. At the transmitter, DNN-based segmentation extracts a semantic map from the source video, decomposing it into multiple sub-signal classes based on multi-user receiver intents. The transmitter broadcasts the semantic map to all users over shared wireless/network resources, thereby utilizing orthogonal resources only to transmit the sub-signal classes intended for each user. Users partially reconstruct and partially synthesize the signal by combining the received intended classes with non-intended classes locally synthesized by a generative model from the semantic map. We derive the rate-distortion/perception curves for reconstruction/synthesis with the generative model, to adaptively set compression rates for the semantic map and intended classes. Generative multicasting significantly reduces the wireless/network resources require

translated_title: 演示：基于设备端意图感知语义分解的实时生成式多播
translated_abstract: 我们展示了一种生成式多播演示，其采用设备端、意图感知的语义分解。在发送端，基于深度神经网络的分割从源视频中提取语义图，并根据多用户接收端的意图将其分解为多个子信号类别。发送端通过共享无线/网络资源将语义图广播给所有用户，从而仅利用正交资源传输针对每个用户的子信号类别。用户通过将接收到的预期类别与本地由生成模型从语义图合成的非预期类别相结合，部分重建并部分合成信号。我们推导了使用生成模型进行重建/合成的率失真/感知曲线，以自适应地设置语义图和预期类别的压缩率。生成式多播显著减少了所需的无线/网络资源。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于设备端意图感知语义分解的生成式多播方法，通过广播共享语义图和仅传输用户特定子信号，显著降低无线资源需求。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a generative multicasting method with on-device intent-aware semantic decomposition, broadcasting shared semantic maps and transmitting only user-specific sub-signals to significantly reduce wireless resource requirements.
